field_qc_rule: Bad total/oil ratio rejects oil field only; total production is validated independently.
mna_rule: Large production changes are accepted when ma_window > 0.
regime_rule: First suspicious production jump is not accepted. If a subsequent observation confirms the same new production level, only the subsequent quarter is accepted as NEW_REGIME_CONFIRMED. No retrospective correction is performed.
guardrail: Structural model is disabled when its historical MAE is not better than V2.1.
